openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: 802.11ac+bgn wireless router based on the MediaTek MT7620A SoC. It has three Ethernet ports and two radios (one SoC-based 2.4 GHz 802.11bgn and one PCI-based MT7612EN 2.4/5GHz 802.11abgnac, wired on 5GHz only, both 2x2 MiMo).
openwrt_wiki.Installation (Kurzfassung): OpenWrt installation process is tricky but possible. It requires registering to Xiaomi's web site to install the development firmware provided by the vendor that enables root SSH access to the device. [...] Another option would be to directly burn the SPI flash chip via a clamp and a buspirate. Danach OpenWrt-Image per mtd in Partition OS1.
openwrt_wiki.Hinweis WLAN: Wifi is nowhere near stable even in stable releases up to Chaos Calmer (durchgestrichen); It seems that the issue of WIFI was fixed in the LEDE trunk with commit b367eef2; WiFi performance of Chaos Calmer 15.05.1 has been very stable, and as good as the original factory firmware.
openwrt_wiki.Hinweis LED: Please note that the OpenWrt binary defaults to the red color of the led instead of the orange/blue during and after finishing the boot.
openwrt_wiki.Stock-Firmware: highly modified OpenWrt 12.09 Attitude Adjustment with a completely different (i.e. non-LuCi) web interface and proprietary drivers like Tuxera NTFS
openwrt_wiki.Rückweg Stock: Entwickler-Firmware als miwifi.bin auf FAT/FAT32-USB-Stick, Reset beim Einstecken des Stroms halten, bis die orange Status-LED blinkt, warten bis blau
openwrt_wiki.Switch: MT7620 built-in 10/100 switch w/ vlan support
openwrt_wiki.Power characteristics: Router consumes between 1.5W and 2.1W, depending on the power supply voltage and load. The power adapter is rated 12V @ 1A . The router can be powered from a battery.
Photos: http://i.imgur.com/Mx5aaHM.jpg (potential location of the serial interface)
openwrt_wiki.Serial (Text): The serial port of the Xiaomi MiWiFi Mini can be accessed using the TTL pins shown in the image below. A voltage level converter (such as a CP2102 TTL-USB dongle) is required. Writing to the console is disabled in the factory U-Boot. Writing to the console in the factory firmware is only possible during first boot; afterwards it is disabled by the firmware. [...] The communication settings are: TTL voltage, 115200 bps, 8N1.
openwrt_wiki.Switch Ports: 0, 1: LAN; 4: WAN; 6: CPU; 2,3,5 and 7 are disconnected. All ports are 100Mbps except the CPU port 6, which shows as 1Gbps
openwrt_wiki.LED colors: 3 LEDs (purple/blue, yellow, red über gpio1 0/2/5); the combination marked as the color blue is really more of a purple color
openwrt_wiki.Bootloader (Text): standard U-boot, not accessible (console write is disabled), immediately boots another bootloader named Ralink U-boot (console write is as well disabled). The Ralink U-boot allows flashing the [factory] firmware to the device using a USB stick when the reset button is pressed on power-up.
